questions.text: An express train covers a certain distance at a uniform speed. If its speed was increased by 16 km/h, it would take 8 hours less than the scheduled time. If its speed was decreased by 16 km/h, it would take 12 hours more than the scheduled time. Find the length of the journey. Ans A). 3640 km B). 3840 km C). 4140 km D). 4040 km Correct Answer: B
A dump truck runs 54 km on 12 liters of fuel. How many kilometres will it run on 60 liters of fuel? Ans A). 270 B). 272 C). 274 D). 268 Correct Answer: A

A cylindrical pillar is 80 cm in diameter and 35 m in height. Find the cost of painting the ₹ curved surface of the pillar at the rate of 45 per m2. Ans A). ₹3,960 B). ₹3,988 C). ₹3,921 D). ₹3,983 Correct Answer: A

A and B can complete a piece of work in 12 days and 18 days respectively. They work together for 4 days, after which A leaves the work. B continues alone for 6 days, and then C joins B. If C alone can complete the whole work in 9 days, find the total time (in days) taken to complete the work. Ans A). B). C). D). Correct Answer: D

On a circular path of 1778 m, Rashika and Shifa start walking from the same point but in the opposite directions at the speed of 5.3 m/s and X m/sec, respectively, they will meet for the first time after 127 seconds. Find the value of X.3462 Ans A). 4.6 B). 6.6 C). 3.8 D). 8.7 Correct Answer: D

A shopkeeper marks an article 60% above its cost price. He offers a discount of 20% on ₹ the marked price and still earns a profit of 840. What is the marked price of the article? Ans A). ₹4800 B). ₹4000 C). ₹6400 D). ₹8400 Correct Answer: A

A sum of money is distributed among Amit, Bharat and Chetan in the ratio of 5 : 7 : 9. If ₹ the share of Bharat is 490 less than the combined share of Amit and Chetan, then what is the total sum of money distributed among them? Ans A). ₹1484 B). ₹1470 C). ₹1449 D). ₹1430 Correct Answer: B

₹ A shopkeeper purchases 240 pens at the rate of 5 pens for 40 and sells them at the rate ₹ of 4 pens for 44. What is the profit percentage earned by the shopkeeper? Ans A). 30% B). 37.5% C). 32.5% D). 35% Correct Answer: B
The arithmetic mean of 21 numbers is 48. The mean of the first 10 numbers is 49 and the mean of the last 10 numbers is 45. Find the 11th number. Ans A). 68 B). 72 C). 88 D). 64 Correct Answer: A

Twice Manvi's age plus Tanvi's age is 37 years. Tanvi's father is twice as old as Tanvi, and Manvi's brother is 5 years older than Manvi. The sum of the ages of Tanvi's father and Manvi's brother is 43 years. Find the sum of the ages (in years) of Manvi and Tanvi. Ans A). 25 B). 30 C). 28 D). 22 Correct Answer: A
If 20% of k is 15 less than 1200% of 10, then k is: Ans A). 565 B). 505 C). 525 D). 485 Correct Answer: C

If TQ = 24 cm, find the value of (TR − PR)/PQ. Ans Correct Answer: C A). B). C). D).

A vendor marks up the cost price of a product by 25% and then offers a 10% discount on the marked price. What is the net profit percentage earned by the vendor? Ans A). 10% B). 12.5% C). 18.5% D). 20% Correct Answer: B

Given that the median of the numbers 15,8,11,21,32,5,25,7 is m. If 15 is replaced by 7, then the new median is n. Find the difference between m and n. Ans A). 4.5 B). 2.5 C). 1.5 D). 3.5 Correct Answer: D
In a trapezium PQRS, PQ∥RS. Calculate ∠R if ∠P = 72° and ∠Q = 54°. Ans A). 72o B). 126o C). 54o D). 108o Correct Answer: B

The average sale of cars by a dealer per day in the month of March, other than on Saturdays and Sundays, is 163. The average sale of cars per day on Sundays is 125. What is the average sale of cars per day on Saturdays, if the first Saturday is on the 3rd of March and average sale of cars per day for the whole month is 171? Ans A). 242 B). 243 C). 247 D). 246 Correct Answer: B

A sum of money invested at compound interest triples itself in 15 years. At the same annual rate of interest, in how many years will it become 27 times its original value? Ans A). 60 years B). 30 years C). 75 years D). 45 years Correct Answer: D
The product of two consecutive prime numbers is 437. The difference between these two prime numbers is: Ans A). 8 B). 6 C). 4 D). 2 Correct Answer: C

₹ Two friends K and G share the profit in the ratio of 7 : 5. If the monthly profit is 72,000, then the share of K is: Ans A). ₹8,000 more than the share of G B). a multiple of 7 C). ₹10,000 more than the share of G D). a multiple of 9 Correct Answer: B

Six years ago from now, Nirbhay was 8 times as old as Vismay. After 6 years from now, he will be 2 times as old as Vismay will then be. The present age of Nirbhay (in years) is: Ans A). 19 B). 23 C). 22 D). 20 Correct Answer: C
A cylindrical tank of radius 7 cm can contain 2156 cm³ of water. What is its height? Ans A). 8 cm B). 10 cm C). 12 cm D). 14 cm Correct Answer: D

Pipe A can fill a tank in 24 hours and Pipe B can fill the same tank in 36 hours. If both pipes are opened together, how long will they take to fill the tank? Ans A). 14 hours B). 16.4 hours C). 16 hours D). 14.4 hours Correct Answer: D
